name: Salmon Fish Fingers with Oven-Baked Fries & Zesty Yogurt Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, peel, and slice potatoes into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a large bowl and add oil and salt; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Spread potatoes out in a single layer on a large baking sheet and place in the lower third of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated). Tossing once halfway through, roast until golden brown, 15-20 minutes. Reserve bowl for next step.
Wash, dry, and zest lemons into the reserved bowl.
Add bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
Slice the crosswise into 1-inch wide fingers.
Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Roll the salmon in the bread crumb mixture, pressing to adhere; place on the prepared baking sheet.
Place salmon in the upper third of the oven and bake until golden, crispy, and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Watch carefully because the bread crumbs can burn quickly.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemons into a medium bowl. Cut the remaining lemon into wedges.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Add yogurt, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide salmon and fries between plates; serve with lemon wedges and yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!
